Chapter 503 - 503 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (2)

Chapter 503 - 503 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (2)

503 Small Gifts; Inhumane! (2)

Lin Fan sat on the soft sofa in the presidential suite and took out his phone to browse.

Soon after, he turned his attention to the 6,010 red packets.

These red packets were the red packets he had received after shopping today.

Lin Fan muttered, “6,000 red packets. Let’s see what I can get.”

[Do you want to open all red packets?]

“Yes!]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Shangri-La Group’s shares.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 99 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received two yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Michelin Group’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you have obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 88 yuan.]

…

Out of the 6,010 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 210,401 yuan. He chose to ignore this amount of money.

Lin Fan had used the one yuan critical hit card several times. He could get 100 million yuan immediately after spending one yuan. It was not bad.

51% of Michelin Group’s shares. Michelin Group’s main business was tires, and its market value was about 140 billion yuan!

51% of the shares meant that he had obtained 70 billion yuan!

As for money… Lin Fan did not care anymore.

More importantly, Michelin Group was not only famous for tires but also for its Michelin grading system for restaurants.

Every Michelin-star restaurant was good, be it the environment or the taste. They were some of Lin Fan’s favorite restaurants.

Now, the entire Michelin Group belonged to him?

…

Finally, Lin Fan’s attention fell on the 51% shares of Shangri-La Group.

The Shangri-La Group’s market value was about 30 billion yuan, and 51% of the shares were about 15 billion yuan.

Besides, the place he was staying at right now was the Shangri-La Hotel?

After staying for two days, he was given the hotel directly?

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and smiled.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Today, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others all woke up very early.

That was because…

Today was the day their professor, Lin Fan, would accept the Fields Medal!

After washing up, they were all in high spirits. They waited excitedly in front of the door of Lin Fan’s presidential suite.

A moment later, Lin Fan finally opened the door slowly.

“Good morning, Professor Lin,” everyone said in unison.

in Fan nodded. “Good morning.”

Then, they went to the dining area and had a sumptuous breakfast.

After that, everyone took the elevator to the lobby on the first floor.

It was also at this moment that a large group of men and women in suits and leather shoes walked over quickly.

It was not surprising that there were people in suits at the Shangri-La Hotel.

After all, this was one of the top hotels in Barney.

Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others thought that they were just ordinary guests like him.

Therefore, they did not pay too much attention to them.

However, this group of people in suits stopped in front of Lin Fan.

Then, they greeted him in unison, “Hello, Mr. Lin!”

Their voices were not loud.

However, after gathering together, it still formed a rather loud sound which attracted the attention of everyone in the lobby.

A middle-aged man wearing gold-rimmed glasses stood at the front and said respectfully, “Mr. Lin, I’m Li Hui, the chairman of Shangri-La Group.

“Thank you very much for your trust in our Shangri-La Group. I will definitely work hard with all the employees… We’ll be sure to strive to make Shangri-La Group better and better…

“Mr. Lin, are you free? I’d like to give you a report on the future development plan of Shangri-La Group and its financial situation over the years.”

Shangri-La Group was founded by Li Hui.

Yesterday, when he found out that 51% of Shangri-La Group’s shares had been suddenly acquired, he felt as if he had been struck by lightning. He had mixed feelings and could not sleep the entire night.

After all, Shangri-La Group was his life’s work.

Now, it had become someone else’s.

This made him doubt himself.

He doubted whether it was right or wrong to expand, raise funds, and go public.

However, it had to be said that Li Hui had a good ability to accept it.

After a sigh, he quickly accepted reality.

Therefore, he took a plane in the early morning and rushed to Barney overnight. He wanted to see the new boss of Shangri-La Group, Lin Fan, as soon as possible.

He wanted to use his utmost sincerity to gain Lin Fan’s goodwill and friendship as soon as possible so that Shangri-La Group could continue to develop.

After Lin Fan heard Li Hui’s words, he waved his hand and said, “I won’t ask or interfere with the specific matters of Shangri-La Group. You can plan your own development. I’ll only receive dividends according to the shares.

“So, you don’t have to report to me.”

Even though Li Hui had already experienced countless storms and had already reached the point where his emotions were not easily stirred, his face revealed unconcealable excitement after hearing Lin Fan’s words.

He would not interfere with the specific matters of Shangri-La Group!

He would only wait to receive the dividends!

Would this not be… no different from the previous circulating shares?

Shangri-La Group’s route would not deviate!

After a while, Li Hui tried his best to suppress the excitement in his heart and said, “Yes, Mr. Lin!”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “That’s all for now. I have something to do later, so I’ll be leaving first.”

After saying that, he strode forward.

Li Hui quickly looked at Lin Fan’s back and said respectfully, “Goodbye, Mr. Lin.”

After they walked out of the Shangri-La Hotel, Hao Zhiwu could not help but ask, “Professor Lin, is that the chairman of the Shangri-La Hotel?”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Yes.”

“I’ve been staying here for the past two days, so I got 51% of Shangri-La Group’s shares.”

His tone was very relaxed and indifferent.

However, it sounded like thunder in the ears of Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, Nie Zhenjiang, and Liu Qianqian.

What did they hear?

He enjoyed his stay here for the past two days, so got 51% of Shangri-La Group’s shares?

Although they did not know the exact market value of Shangri-La Group, based on the reputation of the Shangri-La Hotel, it should be at least tens of billions of yuan, right?

Lin Fan stayed here for two days and spent tens of billions of yuan to buy half of the group?

This…

This…

It was simply inhumane!

Everyone stood rooted to the ground, staring at Lin Fan’s back in a daze.

Lin Fan did not explain that he did not spend tens of billions to buy 51% of Shangri-La Group’s shares. Instead, he opened a red packet.

Of course, even if he explained, they would not believe him.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu suddenly shouted, “I want to study harder! Gaming? Movies? Music? None of them can stop me from learning!

“I want to become like Professor Lin!”

After saying that, he hurriedly ran forward.

After hearing Hao Zhiwu’s words, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others gradually came back to their senses and followed him.

…

At this moment, two Rolls-Royce were already waiting at the door.

Lin Fan, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue sat in the first Rolls-Royce.

As the car door slowly closed, the air immediately became hot.

For some reason, Xia Bing and Xia Xue suddenly recalled the day before yesterday when Lin Fan had come to their room. They recalled the atmosphere at that time and the scene of Lin Fan sticking his head in.

Therefore, Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s two pretty faces were like ripe tomatoes, completely red.

Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and Nie Zhenjiang sat in the second Rolls-Royce.

Hao Zhiwu looked at the watch on his wrist, and the word ‘study’ seemed to be jumping in his eyes.

He immediately took out his phone and opened the biology question bank. Looking at the complicated questions on it, he muttered, “It’s rare for me to be abroad. I’ll just study hard when I go back.

“Yes, I’ll do that!”

After saying that, Hao Zhiwu closed the biology question bank, put on his headphones, and listened to brisk music.
